content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 6

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 6:1 | the-Many | the Congregation | the full assembly | word choice | SOPHIA: "the Assembly" -- compromise for ha-rabbim throughout |
| 2 | 6:1 | bring a matter against | bring a charge against | bring an accusation against | word choice | SOPHIA: "bring a charge against" -- follows LOGOS |
| 3 | 6:2 | the junior the-senior | the junior to the senior | the younger must defer to the older | structural | SOPHIA: "the junior shall defer to the senior" -- hybrid |
| 4 | 6:3 | they shall take-counsel | they shall take counsel | deliberate together | word choice | SOPHIA: "they shall take counsel" -- EMET/LOGOS |
| 5 | 6:4 | let there not be-absent | a priest shall not be absent | a priest must always be present | structural | SOPHIA: "a priest shall not be absent" -- LOGOS negative formulation |
| 6 | 6:6 | the-first-portion-of | the first portion of | the first portion of | word choice | SOPHIA: "the first portion of" -- all three agree |
| 7 | 6:6 | the new-wine | the new wine | the fresh wine | word choice | SOPHIA: "the new wine" -- EMET/LOGOS (tirosh) |
| 8 | 6:8 | the-Many shall keep-watch | the Congregation shall keep watch | the full assembly must maintain a nightly vigil | structural | SOPHIA: "the Assembly shall keep watch" -- LOGOS structure with consensus term |
| 9 | 6:9 | to read in the-Book | to read the Book | reading from Scripture | word choice | SOPHIA: "to read the Book" -- LOGOS |
| 10 | 6:9 | to study judgment | to study the Law | studying its meaning | interpretive | SOPHIA: "to study the Law" -- LOGOS interprets mishpat in Torah-study context |
| 11 | 6:9 | to bless together | to offer blessings together | offering prayers of blessing together | structural | SOPHIA: "to bless together" -- concise EMET/LOGOS form |
| 12 | 6:13 | in the-midst-of the-words-of | interrupt the speech of | interrupt another person while | structural | SOPHIA: "interrupt the speech of" -- LOGOS |
| 13 | 6:14 | his rank that-is-written | the one whose rank is inscribed | someone who outranks him | interpretive | SOPHIA: "the one whose rank is inscribed" -- LOGOS preserves written-rank detail |
| 14 | 6:16 | the-Instructor | the Instructor | the Guardian | word choice | SOPHIA: "the Instructor" -- EMET/LOGOS for mebaqqer |
| 15 | 6:18 | If they tell him | If they grant him leave | If they give him permission | word choice | SOPHIA: "If they grant him leave" -- LOGOS formality |
| 16 | 6:20 | suited-for instruction | fit for the discipline | shows readiness for the community's way of life | interpretive | SOPHIA: "suited for the discipline" -- hybrid of EMET/LOGOS |
| 17 | 6:21 | the-judgments-of the-community | the ordinances of the community | all the community's rules | word choice | SOPHIA: "the ordinances of the community" -- LOGOS |
| 18 | 6:23 | as the-lot falls | as the lot determines | based on the outcome of the assembly's vote | interpretive | SOPHIA: "as the lot determines" -- LOGOS preserves goral terminology |
| 19 | 6:24 | the-purity-of the-Many | the pure food of the Congregation | the assembly's consecrated food | interpretive | SOPHIA: "the pure food of the Assembly" -- LOGOS clarification of tohorat |
| 20 | 6:25 | the-property-of the-Many | the communal property | the community's common funds | word choice | SOPHIA: "the communal property" -- LOGOS |
| 21 | 6:26 | the-multitude-of the-men-of the-covenant | the majority of the men of the covenant | the majority of the covenant members | structural | SOPHIA: "the majority of the men of the covenant" -- LOGOS |
